notes_for_editor: The brief status 'gone' is not supported by any source; proposed 'abandoned' (see corrections). Both sources give the same 1930s build, 1940 abandonment and 1980s date, but the second relies on a Kresek inventory point the author has not visited, so the two may not be independent. No current observation exists. Willhite's page also mentions a 1941 Metsker map ranger station in the valley below; it is not tied to the lookout in the sources, so it is left out. Brief kind 'platform' left unchanged (crow's nest).
